name: Growlanser IV  Wayfarer of the Time: Return
original_name: グローランサーIV Wayfarer of the Time Return
source:
A fandisc that includes an OVA for Growlanser IV and three new stories in a visual novel format with no RPG gameplay whatsoever.

The first story adds a bit more detail about what Rumith and Bauer were doing during the war. 

Second short story details Silvernale's past before she joined the Royal Guard and briefly goes over her relationship with the Ordenail brothers and Munzer.

Third story goes over what happens to the protagonist at the end of the story in the original GLIV scenario.

[adapted from [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/boards/629093-growlanser-wayfarer-of-time/62216881]GameFaqs[/url]]
translation:
一张同人光盘，包括《Growlanser IV》的OVA和三个视觉小说格式的新故事，没有任何RPG游戏玩法。

第一个故事更详细地介绍了鲁米斯和鲍尔在战争期间所做的事情。

第二个短篇故事详细介绍了西尔弗纳尔在加入皇家卫队之前的过去，并简要回顾了她与奥德内尔兄弟和芒泽的关系。

第三个故事讲述了原始GLIV场景中故事结尾时主角发生的事情。

[改编自 [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/boards/629093-growlanser-wayfarer-of-time/62216881]GameFaqs[/url]]
